annotations.title: Civil court fees calculator (EX50, fees from 13 July 2026)

description: Works out the main civil court fees in England and Wales, with fee numbers: the issue fee for money, non-money (such as repairs), possession, goods, costs-only (CPR 46.14) and Solicitors Act claims; hearing fees by track; applications; appeals; detailed assessment by the size of the bill; default costs certificates; enforcement; and creditors' winding-up and bankruptcy petitions, where the official receiver's deposit is shown separately because it is not a court fee. Help with fees is not taken into account.

appeal.description: Any appeal: to the High Court, or in the County Court (small claims, or other claims).

applicationsByConsent.description: How many applications by consent or without notice, e.g. "1".

applicationsOnNotice.description: How many applications on notice, e.g. "1".

assessment.description: Include the detailed assessment fee (N258), which depends on the bill.

billTotal.description: The bill's total including VAT, for the assessment fee, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

billVat.description: The VAT in that total, if known, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

claim.description: What the claim is: "money" (A money claim), "other-remedy" (Repairs or another non-money remedy), "goods" (Recovery of goods), "possession" (Possession of land), "costs-only" (Costs-only proceedings (CPR 46.14)), "solicitors-act" (Assessment of a solicitor’s bill (Solicitors Act 1974, Part 3)), "winding-up" (Creditor’s winding-up petition (a company)), "bankruptcy" (Creditor’s bankruptcy petition (an individual)), "none" (Already issued: later fees only), "insolvency-issued" (Already issued: insolvency or Companies Act proceedings, later fees only).

daAppeal.description: Include the fee for an appeal in detailed assessment proceedings.

dcc.description: Include the fee for a default costs certificate (N254).

enforcement.description: Enforcement methods to include, as true or false: "warrantControl" (Warrant of control), "warrantPossession" (Warrant of possession or delivery), "furtherAttempt" (Further attempt at a new address), "orderInfo" (Order to attend court for questioning), "bailiffService" (Bailiff service of that order), "attachment" (Attachment of earnings order), "charging" (Charging order), "tpdo" (Third party debt order), "judgmentSummons" (Judgment summons), "writ" (High Court writ of control, possession or delivery).

fixedCostsDetermination.description: Include the fee for a fixed costs determination.

hearingValue.description: For a small claims hearing fee where there is no money claim: the sum claimed, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

legalAid.description: The bill is for legal aid costs only (fee 5.1).

moneyBasis.description: Whether that money claim is additional to the other remedy or an alternative to it.

setAside.description: Include the fee for setting aside a default costs certificate.

track.description: The track, for the hearing fee: "small", "fast", "intermediate", "multi", or "" for no hearing fee yet. Ignored, with a note, for a petition or other insolvency proceedings.

value.description: The amount claimed with interest; for a non-money claim, the damages claimed with it, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

valueUnlimited.description: The money claim's value is not limited or not stated.

withMoney.description: A non-money claim also claims money (default true).
